test.title: Alternating Current - Test 5
test.description: Previous Year Questions as Chapter Test
test.syllabus: This test contains questions from all topics of this chapter included in the JEE Main syllabus. It includes a mix of questions from PYQs of JEE Main 2019 - 2025.

question.text: A series LCR circuit consists of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>R</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>80</mn><mo> </mo><mo>Ω</mo></math>. <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>X</mi><mi>L</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><mn>100</mn><mo> </mo><mo>Ω</mo></math>, and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>X</mi><mi>C</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><mn>40</mn><mo> </mo><mo>Ω</mo></math>. The input voltage is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>2500</mn><mo> </mo><mi>cos</mi><mfenced><mrow><mn>100</mn><mi>π</mi><mi>t</mi></mrow></mfenced><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">V</mi></math>. The amplitude of current, in the circuit, is _____  <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">A</mi></math>.

As shown in the figure an inductor of inductance 200 mH is connected to an AC source of emf 220 Vand frequency 50 Hz. The instantaneous voltage of the source is 0 V when the peak value of current is aπ A. The value of a is _____ .

A series LCR circuit is designed to resonate at an angular frequency <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>ω</mi><mn>0</mn></msub><mo>=</mo><msup><mn>10</mn><mn>5</mn></msup><mo> </mo><mi>rad</mi><mo> </mo><msup><mi mathvariant="normal">s</mi><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup><mo>.</mo></math> The circuit draws <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>16</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">W</mi></math> power from <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>120</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">V</mi></math> source at resonance. The value of resistance <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>R</mi></math> in the circuit is ________ <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">Ω</mi><mo>.</mo></math>
At very high frequencies, the effective impedance of the given circuit will be _________Ω.
An alternating emf $\mathrm{E}=110 \sqrt{2} \sin 100 \mathrm{t}$ volt is applied to a capacitor of $2 \mu \mathrm{F}$, the rms value of current in the circuit is _____$\mathrm{mA}$,

In a series <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>LR</mi></math> circuit, power of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>400</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">W</mi></math> is dissipated from a source of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>250</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">V</mi><mo>,</mo><mo> </mo><mn>50</mn><mo> </mo><mi>Hz</mi></math>. The power factor of the circuit is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>0</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>8</mn></math>. In order to bring the power factor to unity, a capacitor of value <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi></math> is added in series to the <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">L</mi></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">R</mi></math>. Taking the value of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi></math> as <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfenced><mfrac><mi mathvariant="normal">n</mi><mrow><mn>3</mn><mi mathvariant="normal">π</mi></mrow></mfrac></mfenced><mo> </mo><mi>μF</mi></math>, then value of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">n</mi></math> is

The frequencies at which the current amplitude in an LCR series circuit becomes <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfrac><mn>1</mn><msqrt><mn>2</mn></msqrt></mfrac></math> times its maximum value, are <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>212</mn><mo> </mo><mi>rad</mi><mo> </mo><msup><mi mathvariant="normal">s</mi><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>232</mn><mo> </mo><mi>rad</mi><mo> </mo><msup><mi mathvariant="normal">s</mi><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup></math>. The value of resistance in the circuit is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>R</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>5</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">Ω</mi></math>. The self inductance in the circuit is _____ <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>mH</mi></math>.

An inductor of inductance 2 μH is connected in series with a resistance, a variable capacitor and an AC source of frequency 7 kHz. The value of capacitance for which maximum current is drawn into the circuit is 1x F, where the value of x is ______.

(Take π=227)

A capacitor of reactance $4 \sqrt{3} \Omega$ and a resistor of resistance $4 \Omega$ are connected in series with an ac source of peak value $8 \sqrt{2} \mathrm{~V}$. The power dissipation in the circuit is ________ W.

An inductor of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>10</mn><mo> </mo><mi>mH</mi></math> is connected to a <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>20</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">V</mi></math> battery through a resistor of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>10</mn><mo> </mo><mi>kΩ</mi></math> and a switch. After a long time, when maximum current is set up in the circuit, the current is switched off. The current in the circuit after <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>1</mn><mo> </mo><mi>μs</mi></math> is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfrac><mi>x</mi><mn>100</mn></mfrac><mo> </mo><mi>mA</mi></math>. Then <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>x</mi></math> is equal to ______ . (Take <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>e</mi><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>37</mn></math>)

An LCR series circuit of capacitance <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>62</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>5</mn><mo> </mo><mi>nF</mi></math> and resistance of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>50</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">Ω</mi></math>, is connected to an A.C. source of frequency <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>2</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>0</mn><mo> </mo><mi>kHz</mi></math>. For maximum value of amplitude of current in circuit, the value of inductance is ____<math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>mH</mi></math>.<math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfenced open=""><mrow><mo>(</mo><mtext>Take</mtext><mo> </mo><msup><mi mathvariant="normal">π</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>=</mo><mn>10</mn></mrow></mfenced></math>

To light, a <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>50</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">W</mi><mo>,</mo><mn>100</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">V</mi></math> lamp is connected, in series with a capacitor of capacitance <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfrac><mn>50</mn><mrow><mi>π</mi><msqrt><mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi></msqrt></mrow></mfrac><mo> </mo><mi>μ</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">F</mi></math>, with <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>200</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">V</mi><mo>,</mo><mo> </mo><mn>50</mn><mo> </mo><mi>Hz</mi><mo> </mo><mi>AC</mi></math> source. The value of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>x</mi></math> will be _____ .

When a $d c$ voltage of $100 \mathrm{~V}$ is applied to an inductor, a $d c$ current of $5 \mathrm{~A}$ flows through it. When an ac voltage of $200 \mathrm{~V}$ peak value is connected to inductor, its inductive reactance is found to be $20 \sqrt{3} \Omega$. The power dissipated in the circuit is _______ W.

A transmitting station releases waves of wavelength <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>960</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi></math>. A capacitor of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>2</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>56</mn><mo> </mo><mi>μ</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">F</mi></math> is used in the resonant circuit. The self-inductance of coil necessary for resonance is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>x</mi><mo>×</mo><msup><mn>10</mn><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>8</mn></mrow></msup><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi></math>. find <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>x</mi></math>

In a series LCR circuit, the inductance, capacitance and resistance are L=100 mH, C=100 μFand R=10 Ω respectively. They are connected to an AC source of voltage 220 V and frequency of 50 Hz. The approximate value of current in the circuit will be _____ A.

An oscillating <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>LC</mi><mo> </mo></math>circuit consists of a <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>75</mn><mo> </mo><mi>mH</mi></math> inductor and a <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>1</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>2</mn><mo> </mo><mo>µ</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">F</mi></math> capacitor. If the maximum charge to the capacitor is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>2</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>7</mn><mo> </mo><mo>µ</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi></math>. The maximum current in the circuit will be <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>_______</mi><mo> </mo><mi>mA</mi></math>.

For a given series LCR circuit it is found that maximum current is drawn when value of variable capacitance is $25 \mathrm{nF}$. If resistance of $200 \Omega$ and $100 \mathrm{mH}$ inductor is being used in the given circuit. The frequency of ac source is ______ $\times 10^3 \mathrm{~Hz}$. (given $\pi^2=10$ )
Two circuits are shown in figure (a) and (b). At a frequency of _______ rad s-1 the average power dissipated in one cycle will be the same in both the circuits.

An inductor of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>0</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>5</mn><mo> </mo><mi>mH</mi></math>, a capacitor of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>20</mn><mo> </mo><mi>μF</mi></math> and resistance of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>20</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">Ω</mi></math> are connected in series with a <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>220</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">V</mi></math> ac source. If the current is in phase with the emf, the amplitude of current of the circuit is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msqrt><mi>x</mi></msqrt><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">A</mi></math>. The value of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>x</mi></math> is-
The effective current I in the given circuit at very high frequencies will be _____ A.
